images.title: Sharing ₹4000 in the ratio 3 : 1
images.purpose: Shows a profit of ₹4000 split into 4 equal groups of 1000, three for Prashanti and one for Bhuvan.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long bar across the middle split into four equal boxes, with a brace above and the two shares below.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal bar with a dark outline, labelled ₹4000 above it with a brace over its whole length. The bar is split into exactly 4 equal boxes, each showing 1000 inside. Boxes 1 to 3 are filled teal (#0072B2); box 4 is filled amber (#E69F00). Under boxes 1 to 3, one teal brace labelled Prashanti ₹3000; under box 4, one amber brace labelled Bhuvan ₹1000. At the right end of the bar, in reddish purple (#CC79A7): 3 : 1. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Sharing in 3 : 1 makes 3 + 1 = 4 equal groups of 1000; one gets 3 groups and the other 1.
